summary: Install-time beacon to attacker-controlled host in dependency-confusion lure
details: @mntv-analysis/ui-components@50.1.1 is a hollow package whose only effective behavior on install is a tracking beacon. package.json declares scripts.preinstall: "node index.js", and index.js issues an HTTPS GET to https://realwbx.com/ip.php on `npm install`, carrying a hardcoded Authorization header value. The scoped @mntv-analysis/* name combined with an implausibly high 50.1.1 version, a placeholder README, no actual UI-component code, and a single-purpose beacon are the canonical dependency-confusion attack shape: the package exists to win internal-package resolution against a private @mntv-analysis scope and to signal successful landing on an installer host. Installation leaks the installer's public IP, timing, and the fact that the attacker's name squat resolved inside the target's build environment to realwbx.com, which is not a vendor endpoint associated with any UI-component library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
